description: This PHP class, 'GenericBasicDisplayField', extends 'BasicDisplayField' and defines a mapping for various employee-related fields used in HR reporting. It provides methods to set display fields based on predefined mappings and retrieve entity and field information.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayField
classes.description: A class that provides a mapping for HR report display fields, allowing dynamic setting of entity and field names based on a predefined map.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field name based on the provided display field's alias, using the predefined mapping.

methods.name: getEntityAlias
methods.description: Returns the entity alias associated with the display field.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the field name associated with the display field.
